subject: Engagement charter & kickoff plan — Cyclone Health
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Rivera <tom@cyclonehealth.com>, Ashley Green <ashley@cyclonehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Engagement charter & kickoff plan — Cyclone Health

Tom / Ashley — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of what we heard, the proposed scope for the engagement, and clear next steps so we can hit a two-week onboarding window. Please reply with any corrections or missing owners.

Pain points (as described):
- High volume of standard support inquiries that drive 60% of live agent load; average time-to-resolution is 18m.
- Need consistent, auditable suggestions for policy-driven responses (HIPAA-adjacent; no PHI ingestion).
- Bursty traffic during morning triage leads to latency spikes and throttled API calls.

Goals for the 6-week engagement (mutual):
1) Demonstrate a 30% reduction in agent-handled volume for the top 5 intents (baseline week included).
2) Maintain model response latency < 350ms p95 in production-like traffic for inference path.
3) Provide an audit trail and prompt/eval suite to ensure no PHI leakage in outputs.

Proposed scope (MVP):
- 2-week setup & data sync: access for Redwood engineers to anonymized conversation logs (redacted) + SSO service account; configure VPC peering into Cyclone test environment or use Redwood Private if required.
- 3-week evaluation: run an internal A/B between current rule-based replies and our candidate model; collect metrics for intent classification precision/recall and operator reduction.
- 1-week wrap & handoff: run prompt-evals, deliver playbook and acceptance report.

Success metrics and acceptance criteria:
- Intent recall >= 0.88 on selected prompts; precision >= 0.85 for auto-response candidates.
- No PHI occurrences across 5k sampled responses (manual spot checks + automated filters).
- Latency p95 < 350ms in test harness under 60 RPS.

Owners & roles (proposed):
- Cyclone primary: Tom Rivera (product lead), Ashley Green (ops lead)
- Redwood primary: Ben Carter (engagement lead), Marissa Cole (solutions engineer), Karthik Iyer (inference engineer)

Initial timeline (target):
- Aug 31–Sep 4: Access & network setup (SSO/service account, sample data snapshot)
- Sep 6–Sep 17: Model tuning + evaluation runs
- Sep 20: Internal acceptance demo + delivery of evaluation report

Access/setup checklist (attachments and notes):
- Attachment: engagement-charter-cyclone-v1.pdf (scope doc and milestones)
- Attachment: prompt-set-sample.csv (seed prompts + evaluation labels)
- Attachment: infra-access-checklist.md (service account name, IP allowlist, S3 path for redacted logs)

Open questions we asked on the call:
- Can you confirm the data transfer method (S3 cross-account vs. temporary upload)?
- Are there any approval gates we should expect from Risk/Legal for the test environment?
- Which Slack channel should we use for day-to-day coordination (ops or product)?

Next steps (action items):
1) Cyclone: share S3 bucket details or confirm preferred transfer (owner: Ashley) — target Aug 31.
2) Cyclone: confirm Risk/Legal checklist items and whether Redwood Private is required (owner: Tom) — target Sep 2.
3) Redwood: provision test model build, send infra access checklist (owner: Karthik) — target Aug 31.
4) Redwood: schedule kickoff runbook walkthrough (owner: Ben) — propose Sep 1 or Sep 2 at 10am PT.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite and the DocuSign link for an engagement addendum if you want to formalize start dates.

—
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

Thanks Ben — that matches our notes. Two quick clarifications:
1) We will provide an S3 cross-account role for a redacted logs snapshot; I’ll send details by EOD Aug 31.
2) Risk will need the infra-access-checklist and a short summary on data handling; they typically sign off within 48–72 hours once they see the checklist.

We’re good to do Sep 1 10am PT for the kickoff walkthrough. I’ll accept a calendar invite.

Ashley
